recentItems.title: ST. PETERSBURG BLITZ: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russian Oil Terminal & Data Centers!
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian forces executed a massive overnight long-range drone attack against St. Petersburg and the Leningrad region, striking the Petersburg Oil Terminal, the Ruchyi fuel depot, and a VKontakte data center. The synchronized strikes triggered massive fires, damaged key transportation bridges, caused power blackouts, and disrupted internet infrastructure, marking a major escalation deep inside Russian territory.

recentItems.title: KOLKATA STAMPEDE HORROR: Eyewitness Recounts Deadly Crush At Chorbagan Durga Puja Pandal!
recentItems.description:
A catastrophic stampede broke out at the crowded Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata, leaving attendees trapped, panicked, and injured amid chaotic scenes. Eyewitnesses recounted harrowing moments of suffocation, struggling children, and frantic rescue efforts as surging festival crowds overwhelmed security barriers and narrow entry points during the high-attendance celebrations.

recentItems.title: GWALIOR TRUCK TRAGEDY: 12 Devotees Killed, 39 Injured Near Sheetla Mata Temple!
recentItems.description:
At least twelve Hindu devotees were killed and nearly forty others injured when an overloaded truck breached police barricades and crashed into crowds near the Sheetla Mata Temple in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh. The speeding vehicle ploughed through pilgrims and shops before hitting the temple wall, triggering massive panic and prompt emergency medical deployment across regional hospitals.
